players.product: high-speed low-loss copper-clad laminate (CCL) for AI server / switch boards

quarterly_data.signal: 1Q26 results: revenue NT$9,143 million (+2.5% QoQ, +20.6% YoY); gross margin 11.42% (4Q25: 14.14%, 1Q25: 14.25%); operating profit NT$424 million (-18.6% YoY), operating margin 4.64%; net income to parent NT$315 million; EPS NT$0.87. Infrastructure revenue +4.0% QoQ and +31.6% YoY in 1Q26; infrastructure was 68% of FY25 revenue by application (automotive 16%, consumer electronics 11%, smartphone 5%).
quarterly_data.figure: 1Q26 revenue NT$9,143 million (+20.6% YoY); GM 11.42%; infrastructure +31.6% YoY

quarterly_data.signal: Manufacturing sites and capacity expansion plan (deck): laminate capacity per month - HsinChu 600K sheets, DongGuan 450K, WuXi 1,650K, JiangXi 2,400K; prepreg HsinChu 1,500K m, DongGuan 1,500K m2, WuXi 4,000K m2, JiangXi 6,000K m2; GuangZhou FCCL 1,150K m2/month. Thailand: Plant 1 (2025-26) laminate 600K sheets/month, Plant 2 (2027-28) laminate 600K sheets/month (prepreg TBD).

Company view: hyperscale data center and AI server upgrades expedite the growth of high speed / frequency material demand, and ITEQ's market share in high speed / frequency material is to 'uplift robustly'; the product line extends to M9 Extreme Low Loss (Df 0.0010~0.0005) above M8 Super Ultra Low Loss (Df 0.0015~0.0010). The company calls itself a worldwide top supplier in high speed / frequency laminate (claim). Deck on AI server CCL content: GPU OAM and UBB boards (content value high) use Ultra Low Loss / VLL CCL at 20 to 30 layers including HDI, vs 14 to 24 layers for the CPU mainboard.
quarterly_data.figure: M9 Df 0.0010~0.0005; AI GPU boards 20 to 30 layers
